results.snippet:
The deal fits a pattern of Western majors handing Nigerian assets to local operators. For US energy firms it signals both the risks of onshore Nigeria and the appetite of domestic buyers to step in.

Shell keeps its most valuable Nigerian positions, including deepwater oil and the Nigeria LNG export plant. Those supply global markets that American buyers and traders follow closely.
